notes:
Manafall 0.1.35 - Windows client

What's new in 0.1.35
- Windows desktop: phone touch overlay (Use/Run/Jump/Atk/Duck + sticks) no longer appears on the main menu / Offline panel. Touch controls only show in-game on Android (or Editor phone preview).
- Patch installer: fixed "Could not start the patch installer" — apply now launches via a detached ApplyPendingPatch-Now.cmd (with powershell/cmd fallbacks) so Quit cannot kill the installer. Desktop Manafall.exe starter is restored on apply.
- Same-version republish preference: newer publishedAt / sha wins when versions tie.

Still true from 0.1.34
- Load Save labels: middle-dot separator no longer shows mojibake on Windows.
- Offline sky / weather cloud and night starfield improvements.
- Cold vs food authority fix; fire douse NRE cleanup; LOD spam silenced.
- Phone/touch UI + mobile performance budget layers for Android builds.
